stem: What were the findings of the 'Teen Labs' study regarding adolescents with Type 2 diabetes who underwent bariatric surgery?

options.text: $95\%$ experienced remission of Type 2 diabetes at three years follow-up.
Most participants regained all lost weight within the first year after surgery.
The surgery was only effective for cardiovascular issues, not metabolic ones.
Surgery was found to be less effective than standard lifestyle interventions for diabetes.

explanation: The study of 242 adolescents showed that nearly all participants with baseline Type 2 diabetes saw remission within three years.
rationale: The outcome for this specific metabolic condition was very high.

optionExplanations.A: The study of 242 adolescents showed that nearly all participants with baseline Type 2 diabetes saw remission within three years.
optionExplanations.B: The data presented showed that weight loss was largely maintained up to the three-year mark.
optionExplanations.C: The study specifically highlighted improvements in both weight and metabolic outcomes like dyslipidemia and diabetes.
optionExplanations.D: The speaker presents bariatric surgery as a more intensive and effective option for severe obesity in adolescents.

source.hint: The outcome for this specific metabolic condition was very high.
